messages.subject_clean: CytoscanHD array cdf file for b38/hg38
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I am trying to use Aroma package to analyse CNVs from CytoscanHD array. I have only found the cdf and other library files in hg19: http://www.aroma-project.org/data/annotationData/chipTypes/CytoScanHD_Array/. I wonder if you happen to have access to have CytoScanHD array cdf and library files in b38/hg38. My other analyses have been done with b38 so it would be great to be consistent.

Thank you very much in advance for your help. I look forward to hearing more form you.

Best wishes,

Phuc Hoang
